product.name: CulinaryPro PulseBlend 650W
product.description: The CulinaryPro PulseBlend 650W is a compact electric blender designed for quick meal prep and smoothies. Its 1.5‑liter stainless‑steel jar holds up to 1.5 liters of liquid or solids, while a 650‑W motor delivers powerful blending in short bursts. The appliance features a pulse button for precise control and a safety lock that prevents operation until the jar is securely attached. A 25‑cm tall, 18‑cm wide body fits easily on most kitchen counters, and the brushed‑silver finish complements contemporary décor. The unit is suitable for smoothies, sauces, and purees, making it a versatile addition to any kitchen.
